description: A full page overwrite without its Facts or takes section holds the fence fence_absent and keeps its rows (GBRA-161 PR 2, B-5). The reference model still required fence == rows, so every schedule that added a fact or take and then overwrote that page reported projection_drift (seeds 5108, 5109, 5113, 5115, 5116 from master 1d04e8ee). The model now accepts a mismatch only while the page has no fence block, the fence_absent hold is recorded and the rows are unchanged since they last matched; a parsed fence with the hold still recorded fails. fence_dropped_then_restored drops both sections, tries a supersede on the held page, then republishes the fenced bytes: the rows must match the restored fences and the hold must be gone.
reproduced_before_fix: 7/7 runs on master 1d04e8ee (4 to 15 projection_drift violations each); 0 on 61e52ec9, the commit before PR 2
